# The model-server calls a slot-profile launch makes on a client session's
# path, one scenario per block. Read by two tests, one per launch path, so
# the two paths are held to the same list: TestSlotFlowParity in cmd/wt-session (the
# -M profile/<name> pin, launchSlotProfileRemote) and TestSlotFlowParity in
# internal/tui (the picker's Enter on a profile row, slot_flow.go). Change
# both paths together.
#
# Both tests serve the same catalog rows:
#   openrouter/a, openrouter/b  cloud, launch
#   omlx/run                    local, running, routed
#   omlx/unknown                local, running, routing unknown (R7)
#   omlx/unrouted               local, running, known not to be routed
#   omlx/idle                   local, stopped, start
#
# Fields:
#   scenario  a name for the subtest
#   slots     slot=model pairs (the default slot is sonnet)
#   calls     the normalized calls, in order, from the launch's first call
#             to the agent's build: catalog (one read), register=<ids> (the
#             client session's register with every distinct slot model, in
#             FilledOrder), start=<id> (the start job), build (the agent's
#             command against the gateway). A ping, a job poll, a heartbeat
#             and the client session's end are left out.

scenario: cloud only
slots: sonnet=openrouter/a haiku=openrouter/b
calls: catalog register=openrouter/a,openrouter/b build

scenario: local running and routed
slots: sonnet=openrouter/a haiku=omlx/run
calls: catalog register=openrouter/a,omlx/run build

scenario: local running, routing unknown
slots: sonnet=openrouter/a haiku=omlx/unknown
calls: catalog register=openrouter/a,omlx/unknown build

scenario: local running, known unrouted
slots: sonnet=openrouter/a haiku=omlx/unrouted
calls: catalog register=openrouter/a,omlx/unrouted start=omlx/unrouted build

scenario: local stopped
slots: sonnet=openrouter/a haiku=omlx/idle
calls: catalog register=openrouter/a,omlx/idle start=omlx/idle build
